content: आश्रमः, -मम् [आ-श्रम् आधारे घञ् वृद्धयभावः] .²1 A hermitage, hut, cell, dwelling or abode of ascetics; शरणान्यशरण्यानि आश्रमाणि कृतानि नः <ls>Rām. 7. 6. 5</ls>. .²2 A stage, order, or period of the (religious) life of a Brāhmaṇa [These are four:-- ब्रह्मचर्य the life of a student; गार्हस्थ्य the life of a house-holder; वानप्रस्थ the life of an anchorite or hermit, and संन्यास the life of a Bhikṣu or beggar. Kṣatriyas (and Vaiśyas also) can enter, upon the first three Āśramas; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ś. 7. 18</ls>; <ls>V. 5</ls>; (according to some authorities they can enter the fourth also; <ab>cf.</ab> स किलाश्रममन्त्यमाश्रितः <ls>R. 8. 14</ls>; पूर्वाश्रमः <ls>Ku. 5. 50.</ls>)] .²3 A college, school. .²4 A wood or thicket (where ascetics practise penance). .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu.
